resources.string: Paste the token @BotFather gave you. The bot is added as a separate account.
Telegram does not let a bot download its chat list, contacts or old history. Chats show up here as messages arrive and stay saved on this device.
Log in with a bot token
This does not look like a bot token. It should look like 123456789:AA…
This bot token has been revoked. Get a new one from @BotFather.
Chats appear here when somebody writes to your bot or the bot is added to a group.
Enter a @username, a t.me link or a numeric ID.
Older messages cannot be loaded for a bot account.
